description: Fichier IRVE Gireve is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by GIREVE. Background In order to set up a national directory of charging infrastructure for electric vehicles (IRVE), open and accessible to all, local authorities carrying out an IRVE installation project must, as the stations are put into service, publish on the data.gouv.fr platform static and dynamic data relating to the location and technical characteristics of these ... Coverage: GIREVE. The portal shows the English title as "IRVE Gireve file" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is GIREVE. Its keywords include irve, etalab-schema-irve-consolidation, borne-de-recharge, station-de-recharge-ve, station-de-charge, fichier-irve-des-bornes-de-recharge. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
